about.title: Full Stack Developer
about.subtitle: Based in Argentina
about.bio: Four years in hospitality taught me to obsess over user experience. Now I build software that makes life easier, for users and the people behind it.

items.summary: Three-year degree pursued alongside freelance and personal projects. Covers software architecture, data structures, databases, object-oriented programming, algorithms, and modern web development. Adds academic grounding to the work I've been shipping in production, and opens the door to more rigorous backend and systems territory.

Intensive 9-week full-stack program in Tokyo, covering Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, relational databases, REST APIs, and LLM integration. Pair programming, code reviews, and project-based learning from day one. The final two weeks were a team-built capstone ([Nihongo Hero](#projects)) where I led the four-person dev team and shipped a deployed mobile-first PWA.

items.title: Jidou Navi
items.description: Crowdsourced mobile app for discovering Japan's unique vending machines, with an interactive map and gamified check-ins. Sole developer since early 2026 (started with a partner), owning frontend, backend, and mobile deployment. Currently in closed testing on Google Play Store.

items.title: El Alto
items.description: Website for a cabin rental complex in Tanti, Córdoba, Argentina. Built a chatbot-style contact form that collects dates and guest count before opening WhatsApp, solving the problem of empty 'Hola' messages. Integrated Sanity CMS for self-service price updates and Google Analytics for conversion tracking.

items.title: Nihongo Hero
items.description: A gamified Japanese language learning app with RPG-style turn-based combat. Led 4-person team development in 2 weeks, designing database architecture, integrating VoiceVox TTS API, and serving as top contributor. Deployed as mobile-first PWA.

items.title: Adventure Maker
items.description: AI-powered interactive storytelling platform with branching narratives. Developed LLM prompt engineering for dynamic story generation, implemented Gemini API image generation, and built a psychological assessment analyzing user patterns.
